dt-example.title: Select
dt-example.info:
The [Select extension](https://datatables.net/manual/extensions/select) for DataTables allows the items in the table (usually rows, as in this example) to be selected. The items that are selected are part of the state of the table, and thus will integration with StateRestore. This example demonstrates that ability.
The `select` option of `-init stateRestore.include` option is set to `null` in this example, so you can selectively include, or exclude, the row selection in the state.
